# Microsoft Developer

> > Central hub for Microsoft developer tools, platforms, and programs including Azure, Microsoft 365, Visual Studio, Microsoft Edge, and Windows development resources.

This site serves as the primary entry point for developers building on Microsoft technologies, offering developer programs, SDKs, tools, and documentation. It provides access to cloud development platforms, embedded browser controls, automation tools, and community resources across the Microsoft ecosystem.

## Key Topics

- Azure
- Microsoft 365
- Visual Studio
- Visual Studio Code
- Microsoft Edge WebView2
- Windows
- Microsoft Edge WebDriver
- Cross-platform development
- Developer tools
- Cloud development
- Browser automation
- Embedded browser
- API reference
- Code samples
- Developer community

## Core Developer Resources

- [Microsoft Developer](https://developer.microsoft.com/en-us/): Main developer hub for Microsoft products, Azure, and Visual Studio tools
- [Microsoft 365 Developer Program](https://developer.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-365/dev-program): Microsoft 365 Developer Program with free E5 sandbox and sample data

## Microsoft Edge Development Tools

- [Microsoft Edge WebView2](https://developer.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-edge/webview2?form=MT00EZ): Edge WebView2 product page for Chromium-based native app integration
- [Microsoft Edge WebDriver](https://developer.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-edge/tools/webdriver/?form=MA13LH): Download page for Edge WebDriver browser automation and testing tools

## Downloads and Runtimes

- [Microsoft Edge WebView2 Consumer Download](https://developer.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-edge/webview2/consumer/?form=MA13LH): Consumer download page for Edge WebView2 runtime and embedded browser
